findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the quat based sanitizer in the three part sink was observed low on the inspector’s test strips. Per employees the dish machine is not used on Fridays (today) meaning that the three part sink is the only dish cleaning method being utilized today. The PIC stated that it was about time to change out the water anyway and did so during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective concentrations at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

An employee was observed to use their bare hand to turn off the faucet after hand washing. Education was conducted and should be passed on to employees and staff. Ensure that proper hand washing is taking place at all times.

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records
findings.citation_text:
3-501.19  (P) Observed corn dogs sitting out prior to being taken to classrooms. Observed garlic bread at room temperature and grilled cheese thawing on the counter. When using time as a control, there must be a written policy.

When a maximum time period of 4 hours is used for food safety, TCS food must have an initial temperature of 41°F or less when removed from cold holding temperature control, or 135°F or greater when removed from hot holding temperature control. Discussed the HACCP concept with the person in charge. Reference 3-501.19.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed an excessive accumulation of drain flies (20+), dead, on the floor of the dry storage room. Manager states they just had the facility treated for drain flies due to an issue at the utility sink. Ensure that the floors are regularly cleaned, or cleaned when needed, to prevent this accumulation. Floors swept during the inspection. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Rooms and equipment - vented as required
findings.comment:
Facility was cooking without utilization of the ventilation system. System was turned on during the inspection. Ensure that any time cooking is being done under the hood, or use of heat producing equipment, that the hood system is turned on. 
750-1250 All rooms shall have sufficient ventilation to keep them free of excessive, heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes. Provide adequate ventilation.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the blade of the meat slicer to have chips. Ensure that food contact surfaces are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state. Repair or replace the blade. 
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the prep table, with the prep sink, to be immovable and not caulked to the wall. Ensure that tables or sinks that are immovable are caulked to the wall to ensure a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed that the light fixture in the walk in cooler is not working.
750-1230(b)(2) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide, at a distance of 30 inches from the floor at least 10 foot-candles of light in walk-in refrigeration, dry storage areas, and in all other areas.
Repair light fixture in walk in cooler.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Observed a divider custom made for a utensil drawer that is constructed of raw wood.
Coat or seal this equipment so as to be smooth and washable.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed that the floor under the shelves holding the microwave has some dust.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
Clean the floor in this area.
